Hooks добавляются в settings.json Claude: Hooks are added to Claude Code’s settings.json (other settings are left alone, and a copy is saved next to it before any change). They record the state of every Claude Code session on this computer so AI Hub Bar can show it in the panel.
Windows прячет новые значки под «^». Что: Windows hides new icons under “^”. To keep AI Hub Bar in view: Settings → Personalization → Taskbar → Other system tray icons.
Войдите в Claude Code: claude → /login: Sign in to Claude Code: claude → /login

Сервер лимитов просит запрашивать реже: The limits server asks for fewer requests
